PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-pre-002.text: All required OAuth params (client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, state) must be non-null.
PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-pre-002.assertion: clientId != null && redirectUri != null && codeChallenge != null && state != null

locations.note: if (!clientId || !redirectUri || !codeChallenge || !state) => 400 — note: code_challenge_method not in required check
